title: Segmentation rollout phases and TF fallback notes (draft)
content:
Purpose: capture a lightweight, pragmatic rollout plan for segmented VPC activations (customer-isolation zones) plus notes on Terraform module fallback patterns and upgrade-safe practices. This is an operational draft — very much a working doc.

Context and goals:
- Problem: customers want strong network-level isolation for private deployments but also expect predictable upgrade windows and fast troubleshooting paths.
- Goal: propose a staged rollout pattern that minimizes blast radius during model/runtime upgrades and provides an operator-friendly TF module surface for on-prem + VPC installs.
- Constraints: some customers are air-gapped, some use cloud-VPC peering, others want egressless mode with proxy injection. Need one coherent set of patterns that are parameterizable.
